product: Q2 2026 (2026-08-03): Xywav $471.2M +13% (about 17,125 active patients), Epidiolex $292.1M +16%, Zepzelca $105.8M +42%, Modeyso $48.2M, Ziihera $15.4M. Incremental demand now centres on newly approved Ziihera in first-line HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (2026-08-25) and the rare epilepsy franchise.
demand: Volume and patient-led, not price. Xywav +13% on about 525 net patient adds (2026-08-03); Epidiolex +16% on continued demand; Zepzelca +42% on first-line maintenance uptake. The company cites no price contribution. Ziihera 1L approval (2026-08-25) adds new volume rather than price.
pricing_power: Higher royalties on Modeyso and Zepzelca plus acquisition inventory step-up already cut GAAP gross margin to 90.4% versus 92.1% non-GAAP (2026-08-03). Risks: acquired IPR&D charges ($77M in 2Q26; $905M in 2Q25), interest on $4.4B debt plus $1.25B new notes (2026-08-31), and Ziihera launch spend.
competition: Closest substitute is biosimilar trastuzumab plus generic chemotherapy in first-line GEA, versus Ziihera (2026-08-25). For rare epilepsies, off-label generic antiseizure drugs (limited benefit) remain the cheap option (2026-08-10). No Chinese KCNT1 inhibitor or oxybate substitute was found.
market_strategy: CEO Renee Gala said on 2026-08-03 that 2Q26 drove a considerable increase to full-year revenue guidance, raised to $4.60-4.75B. On 2026-09-15 she pledged to move with urgency and rapidly advance ABS-1230 for KCNT1-related epilepsy. On 2026-08-10 she targeted closing the Actio acquisition by Q4 2026.
bull: 2Q26 revenue $1,208.3M +16% with raised 2026 guidance $4.60-4.75B (2026-08-03 8-K); Ziihera 1L HER2+ GEA approved 2026-08-25 with OS 26.4 vs 19.2 months; Actio closed 2026-09-15 ahead of target.
bear: Ziihera 1L revenue not yet in any print and carries a Boxed Warning with 84% diarrhea and 13% discontinuation; GAAP gross margin fell to 90.4% on royalties and step-up; $4.4B debt plus $1.25B new notes.
falsifier: A 2026 revenue print below the $4.60B guidance floor, or a negative second interim overall survival from HERIZON-GEA-01 doublet due 3Q26 (company-stated 2026-08-03).
web_what_changed_30_90d: Last 30 days: closed $1.25B of 1.875% exchangeable notes due 2032 and repurchased ~$225M shares at $249.29 (2026-08-31, SEC 8-K); completed $820M Actio Biosciences acquisition (2026-09-15, SEC 8-K); repriced term loan B, margin -50bps, maturity extended to 2033 (2026-09-23, SEC 8-K). Last 90 days: FDA approved Ziihera in 1L HER2+ GEA (2026-08-25) and 2Q26 revenue rose 16% with raised guidance (2026-08-03).
web_true_now_not_modelled: Ziihera first-line HER2+ GEA sales only begin after the 2026-08-25 FDA approval, so no 1L revenue is in 2Q26 (Ziihera BTC was just $15.4M). The 2026 guidance of $4.60-4.75B was set 2026-08-03, before launch. The new $1.25B exchangeable notes and repriced term loan (2026-09-23) also post-date most models.
web_demand_product: Q2 2026 (2026-08-03): Xywav $471.2M +13% (about 17,125 active patients), Epidiolex $292.1M +16%, Zepzelca $105.8M +42%, Modeyso $48.2M, Ziihera $15.4M. Incremental demand now centres on newly approved Ziihera in first-line HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (2026-08-25) and the rare epilepsy franchise.
web_price_volume_mix: Volume and patient-led, not price. Xywav +13% on about 525 net patient adds (2026-08-03); Epidiolex +16% on continued demand; Zepzelca +42% on first-line maintenance uptake. The company cites no price contribution. Ziihera 1L approval (2026-08-25) adds new volume rather than price.
web_bottleneck: Ziihera uptake depends on HER2 testing at diagnosis and on managing severe diarrhea: Boxed Warning, diarrhea in 84% (fatal 1.5% with tislelizumab), permanent discontinuation 13% (2026-08-25). ABS-1230 targets only about 2,500 US KCNT1 patients with no approved therapy (2026-08-10). Commercial execution and testing are the constraint.
web_who_benefits_next: BeOne Medicines (Tevimbra/tislelizumab partner) and Zymeworks (zanidatamab licensor) gain from the Ziihera approvals (2026-08-25); AbCellera from the 2026-06-17 collaboration; Werewolf via JZP898; Actio holders earn up to $500M milestones (2026-08-10). Actio SpinCo keeps ABS-0871 and Jazz holds a minority stake (2026-09-15).
web_who_loses: Trastuzumab-based regimens (Herceptin, Roche/Genentech) lose the first-line HER2+ GEA standard of care: Ziihera median OS 26.4 vs 19.2 months and PFS 12.4 vs 8.1 months (2026-08-25). Off-label generic antiseizure drugs face displacement in KCNT1 epilepsy if ABS-1230 succeeds (2026-08-10).
web_margin_collapse_risk: Higher royalties on Modeyso and Zepzelca plus acquisition inventory step-up already cut GAAP gross margin to 90.4% versus 92.1% non-GAAP (2026-08-03). Risks: acquired IPR&D charges ($77M in 2Q26; $905M in 2Q25), interest on $4.4B debt plus $1.25B new notes (2026-08-31), and Ziihera launch spend.
web_low_cost_substitute: Closest substitute is biosimilar trastuzumab plus generic chemotherapy in first-line GEA, versus Ziihera (2026-08-25). For rare epilepsies, off-label generic antiseizure drugs (limited benefit) remain the cheap option (2026-08-10). No Chinese KCNT1 inhibitor or oxybate substitute was found.
web_ceo_promised: CEO Renee Gala said on 2026-08-03 that 2Q26 drove a considerable increase to full-year revenue guidance, raised to $4.60-4.75B. On 2026-09-15 she pledged to move with urgency and rapidly advance ABS-1230 for KCNT1-related epilepsy. On 2026-08-10 she targeted closing the Actio acquisition by Q4 2026.
web_did_they_deliver: Yes. The guidance raise accompanied a 16% Q2 revenue beat (2026-08-03). Ziihera 1L GEA was approved on the 2026-08-25 PDUFA date (SEC 8-K 2026-08-25). The Actio deal announced 2026-08-10 closed 2026-09-15, ahead of the stated Q4 2026 target (SEC 8-K 2026-09-15).
web_what_would_falsify: A 2026 revenue print below the $4.60B guidance floor, or a negative second interim OS from HERIZON-GEA-01 (doublet) due 3Q26 (company-stated 2026-08-03), would falsify. Also a failed ABS-1230 KYRON Phase 1b/2a trial, or a Ziihera 1L GEA launch that stalls well below the BTC run-rate.
